sections.heading: Non-Seedlings programs withdrawal and refund policy
sections.html:
(Circle of Song)

Should you need to withdraw from programs once fees are paid, you will need to notify Sunflower in writing at least one week in advance of the last class you will be attending.

After we have received your written notice of intent to withdraw (please specify the last class you will be attending if you are not withdrawing effective immediately), you will receive a refund of your paid program fees, minus a 5% administrative charge.

You will not be refunded for any class that occurs less than 8 days after we receive your written notice of intent to withdraw.

*Special exceptions (medical and family emergency) will be considered on a case-by-case basis.
